title: BC Real Estate Trading Services — Study Companion
edition: Based on the UBC Sauder Trading Services Licensing Course, 2026 edition

blocks.title: Legal foundation
blocks.blurb: Where law comes from, what you actually own, and how title works.

blocks.title: Regulation & conduct
blocks.blurb: The rules of your licence: RESA, BCFSA, liability, money laundering, ethics.

blocks.title: Contracts & agency
blocks.blurb: The documents you draft and the duties you owe while drafting them.

blocks.title: Finance & mortgages
blocks.blurb: Interest math, mortgage law and how lenders decide to lend.

blocks.title: Land, buildings & value
blocks.blurb: Zoning, property taxes, construction and the three approaches to value.

blocks.title: Business, closing & practice
blocks.blurb: Financial statements, completion, adjustments, marketing and technology.

lessons.title: Fundamentals of Law
lessons.summary: The operating system the rest of the course runs on: where law comes from, how BC's courts and tribunals fit together, how a lawsuit runs, and the deadlines that can wipe out a claim.
topics: BC courts and the Civil Resolution Tribunal

lessons.title: Estates and Interests in Land
lessons.summary: What a buyer actually acquires. The bundle of rights you're selling, the smaller rights other people can hold over the same land, and the ways people co-own it.
topics: Fee simple, life estate, estate pur autre vie
Joint tenancy vs tenancy in common
Torts affecting land (trespass, nuisance and more)

lessons.title: Subdivision and Title Registration
lessons.summary: How land is carved into parcels, and how BC's Torrens system guarantees who owns what. Learning to read a title search starts here.
topics: Crown, private and treaty settlement lands
Traditional, strata and air space parcel subdivisions
How a strata development is created
Torrens: indefeasibility, registration, no doctrine of notice, assurance fund

lessons.title: RESA I — Licensing and the Regulator
lessons.summary: The statute that created your profession. What needs a licence, who is exempt, the levels of licence, and who regulates you.
topics: Trading, rental property management and strata management services
Real Estate Foundation, E&O Insurance Corporation, Compensation Fund

lessons.title: RESA II — Trust, Rules, Discipline, REDMA
lessons.summary: Handling other people's money, the day-to-day Rules, what happens when licensees break them, and the special regime for pre-sale developments.
topics: The Real Estate Development Marketing Act

lessons.title: Liability, FINTRAC and Ethics
lessons.summary: How licensees get sued and disciplined, your anti-money-laundering obligations, and the professional standard you're held to.
topics: Duties to clients and third parties

lessons.title: The Law of Contract
lessons.summary: What turns a conversation into a binding contract, what makes one fail, and what happens when it's broken.
topics: Void, voidable, illegal and unenforceable contracts

lessons.title: Contracts for Real Estate Transactions
lessons.summary: The documents you'll actually draft: listing contracts, the contract of purchase and sale, subject clauses and the property disclosure statement.

lessons.title: The Law of Agency
lessons.summary: Who you work for, what you owe them, and the disclosure forms BC requires before you start.

lessons.title: Commercial and Residential Tenancies
lessons.summary: Two completely different rulebooks: freely negotiated commercial leases, and the heavily regulated residential tenancy regime.

lessons.title: Strata Properties and Cooperatives
lessons.summary: How condos are governed and financed, and how cooperatives differ from them.

lessons.title: Mortgage Finance and Interest Math
lessons.summary: The first calculator chapters. How interest really works, and how to compute payments and balances on the HP 10bII+.

lessons.title: Mortgage Law, Analysis and Underwriting
lessons.summary: The legal side of mortgages, how financing changes a deal, and how lenders decide whether to lend to a home buyer or a commercial borrower.

lessons.title: Local Government Law and Property Taxes
lessons.summary: What can be built where, and every tax that touches buying, holding and selling property in BC.

lessons.title: Construction and Appraisal
lessons.summary: How buildings are put together, and how value is estimated using the direct comparison, cost and income approaches.

lessons.title: Financials, Completion, Marketing and Technology
lessons.summary: Reading business financial statements, getting a deal from contract to completion, statements of adjustments, and running your practice.
topics: Balance sheet, income statement, tax return
